Founded in 1995 as a battery manufacturer, BYD has leveraged its expertise in energy storage to compete with Tesla as the leader in worldwide EV sales each [quarter](https://www.investopedia.com/terms/q/quarter.asp). A pandemic-era slump and other industry shifts meant companies like Hertz ([HTZ](https://www.investopedia.com/markets/quote?tvwidgetsymbol=HTZ)) started selling off thousands of their Tesla EVs, putting these bargain-priced alternatives in competition with Tesla’s new vehicles—enough that if they counted as new cars, they would be among Tesla’s top three competitors in 2024.19. This is among the reasons Tesla’s market capitalization is so many times greater than that of companies like Ford and GM, whose [sales](https://www.investopedia.com/ask/answers/122214/what-difference-between-revenue-and-sales.asp) dwarf Teslas.
